# Data Source: myjfrog_private_links

Provides a MyJFrog [PrivateLink](https://jfrog.com/help/r/jfrog-hosting-models-documentation/configure-privatelink-for-jfrog-cloud) data source to list PrivateLink connections for a JFrog cloud server.

->This data source is supported only on the Cloud (SaaS) platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "myjfrog_private_links" "myjfrog-private-links" {
  server_name = "myserver"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `server_name` (String) JFrog server name to search PrivateLink connections for.

### Read-Only

- `private_links` (Attributes List) List of PrivateLink connections for the server and their status values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_links))

<a id="nestedatt--private_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `private_links`

Read-Only:

- `private_link_id` (String)
- `status` (String) PrivateLink status value. One of: `connected`, `connecting`, `removing`, `FAILED (not found)`, `FAILED (internal issue)`.
